### Getting Started

1. Download `WinToolBridge.exe` (or `WinToolBridge_arm64.exe` for ARM64 devices) from the Assets below.
2. Run the executable (it will automatically minimize to your system tray).
3. Visit [https://crjim.com/wintool](https://crjim.com/wintool) to start using the native tools.
